assessment: Marchetti and colleagues present a promising, ex vivo culture method for the adult Drosophila midgut and other abdominal organs. Highlights include demonstrated organ viability for up to 72 hours and protocols for ex vivo injury and genetic manipulation. These advances enable the first real-time lineages tracking multiple stem cell divisions, which reveal intriguing spatial-temporal behavior patterns. The manuscript provides a thorough and thoughtful evaluation of these dynamic data and includes additional information about imaging parameters that will be invaluable to those seeking to replicate this method.
